title: React Aria labels re-render 18× per store update and change nothing
why: The component is a minified, anonymous ForwardRef(t). You'd never find it by name.
finding: The commit at T=9.3s blocked for 66.2ms with 143 fibers, 124 of them wasted. `ForwardRef(t)` at `0fea-ihv~kq4d.js:657` re-rendered 18 of 19 instances. The same pattern repeats at T=9.8s.
actual: The paragraph renders at rgb(154, 155, 163) on an effective backdrop of rgb(251, 251, 252), a contrast ratio of 2.67:1 — below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum — so the text appears as faint gray that is hard to read on the white empty-state card.
expected: The helper paragraph text should have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the white empty-state card background (WCAG AA for 13px normal text), e.g. by using a darker gray token like the heading's #4a4b53 or another ≥4.5:1 muted color.

chronology.text: On the Reminders "Today" view with the search term "haircut" yielding 0 reminders, the empty-state card ("Nothing here yet") is displayed and its helper line "Try a different search or clear the filter." renders as faint gray text on the near-white card — measured contrast 2.67:1 (foreground rgb(154, 155, 163) on effective backdrop rgb(251, 251, 252) from the painted-below div.rounded-2xl), below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum.

rootCause.text: The reminders empty-state component hardcodes the helper paragraph's text color as text-[#9a9ba3] (rgb(154, 155, 163)) at 13px (source: reminders empty-state JSX, class "mx-auto mt-2 max-w-xs text-[13px] leading-5 text-[#9a9ba3]"). Against the card's near-white effective backdrop rgb(251, 251, 252) (the div.rounded-2xl painted beneath the transparent-background paragraph), rgb(154, 155, 163) has a relative-luminance contrast ratio of 2.67:1 — below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum for normal-size text. The token itself is simply too light for body-size text on this surface; the adjacent heading uses #4a4b53 and passes.

rootCauseSteps.text: The paragraph's own background is transparent, so the browser paints the text over the near-white div.rounded-2xl card surface beneath it — the resolved effective backdrop is rgb(251, 251, 252) (measured via ancestor background walk at Point:49).

rgb(154, 155, 163) on rgb(251, 251, 252) computes to a 2.67:1 contrast ratio (measured), below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum for 13px normal text, so the user sees the empty-state helper line as faint gray that is difficult to read on the white card.
